meta.name: kpi-dashboard-design
meta.description: Design effective KPI dashboards with metrics selection, visualization best practices, and real-time monitoring patterns. Use this skill when building an executive SaaS metrics dashboard tracking MRR, churn, and LTV/CAC ratios; designing an operations center with live service health and request throughput; creating a cohort retention analysis view for a product team; or debugging a dashboard where metrics contradict each other due to inconsistent calculation methodology.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计出反映业务关键指标的优质仪表板
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要为客户或团队搭建业务数据看板
copy.tagline_en: Design a clear dashboard for your key business metrics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build a clear data dashboard for your business.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 按战略/战术/运营三层框架和 SMART 原则组织、筛选 KPI；布局时给执行摘要、部门视图、明细钻取三级方案，并附带关键指标与可视化规范。遇到指标冲突或实时刷新性能问题，也会提供排查和修复建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出搭建面向高管、跟踪 MRR/流失/LTV/CAC 的看板，设计带实时健康度和吞吐量的运营中心，或调试指标相互矛盾的仪表盘等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭一个跟踪 MRR、流失和 LTV/CAC 的高管看板
say.note: 会给出分层指标和摘要布局建议。

say.text: 实时运营看板要展示服务健康度和吞吐量，该用哪些指标？
say.note: 会建议实时刷新频率与可视化方案。

say.text: 我仪表盘里的 MRR 和财务数字对不上，怎么排查？
say.note: 会帮你统一折算口径并给出 SQL 示例。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the strategic/tactical/operational KPI framework and SMART selection; recommends 5–7 key metrics, hierarchy with summaries/drilldowns, and visual practices; troubleshoots metric conflicts and live-refresh issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building an executive SaaS dashboard tracking MRR/churn/LTV-CAC, designing a real-time operations center, or debugging metric inconsistencies due to mismatched calculations.

say_en.text: Build an executive dashboard tracking MRR, churn, and LTV/CAC.
say_en.note: It suggests KPI tiers and a summary layout.

say_en.text: What metrics should a live ops dashboard show for health and throughput?
say_en.note: It explains real-time update and visual patterns.

say_en.text: My dashboard MRR doesn't match finance. How do I debug it?
say_en.note: It standardizes the calculation and gives a formula.
